title: Hippocratic embryonic heat-air feedback loop
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. De natura pueri 12 describes a complete recurrent mechanism: male and female generative material mixes, thickens and heats; heated material holds breath, makes a central passage, expels warm air, then draws cooler air back through the opening, repeating through time. A finite loop operator carries one embryo identity through HEAT, VENT, DRAW and NOURISH cycles, while the same rule is extended by analogy to heated wood, leaves, foods and drinks. A one-way maturation rival predicts no repeated return-flow or cross-domain analogy.

source.work: Hippocratic Corpus, De natura pueri / On the Nature of the Child, section 12.1
source.source_span: The complete bounded section 12.1 on mixed generative material, heating, breath passage, warm-air exit, cool-air intake and the stated analogy to heated wood, leaves, foods and drinks.
source.provenance: Eulogikon identifies the work as an anonymous late-fifth- or fourth-century BCE Ionic treatise and displays the Greek section 12.1. This card models the source claim and does not treat its physiology as present medical fact or a target Vorlage.

duplicate_screen.checked: IDEA000322 Aristotle vessel-development source; IDEA000438 Hippocratic prognosis; prior transformation and state-delta cards.
duplicate_screen.difference: The proposed content is a recurrent feedback loop with a source-written cross-domain analogy. It does not assign vessel counts, diagnose a patient, or merely record sparse field updates.

component_functions.MIX: opens one embryo-associated mixture from two source contributions; it does not name either contributor as the later embryo.
component_functions.HEAT: changes mixture condition and enables the channel rule.
component_functions.VENT: creates the central passage once; subsequent cycles reuse it.
component_functions.EXPEL/DRAW: are ordered opposites in one cycle, not interchangeable synonyms.
component_functions.FEED: binds the drawn cool air to the continuing embryo process; it does not create a new embryo.
component_functions.ANALOGIZE: reuses the same heat-air cycle for the source-listed heated wood, leaves, foods and drinks as separate analogue domains.
component_functions.WHOLE_RESIDUAL: selects MIX, VENT_LOOP, or ANALOGY within this process family; it cannot insert an unmentioned organ or developmental stage.

worked_example: cycle1 = EXPEL(ch, warm_air); cycle1b = DRAW(ch, cool_air); e2 = FEED(e1, cycle1b)
cycle2 = EXPEL(ch, warm_air); cycle2b = DRAW(ch, cool_air); e3 = FEED(e2, cycle2b)
close = retain embryo=e3 and channel=ch; no silent new participant is created by either repeat.
constructor.observable_consequence: A complete reading under this constructor must preserve one continuing embryo and a reusable central passage across at least two cycles, while allowing the same ordered cycle to be stated for the listed non-embryonic heated materials. A one-way heat-to-growth rival cannot produce the repeated warm-out/cool-in alternation or the explicit cross-domain analogy.
rivals: ONE_WAY_MATURATION: heat changes the mixture once and growth proceeds without a reusable air channel.
NEW_OBJECT_PER_CYCLE: every warm/cool pair starts a new embryo or passage, losing source continuity.
ANALOGY_AS_DECORATION: treats the wood/leaf/food clause as an unrelated list instead of applying the same declared cycle.
constructor.falsifier: Reject if the same written cycle needs incompatible input/output types, if the second cycle requires a fresh channel without a source reset, or if the analogy can change operation order. The source does not establish modern embryological truth and does not identify target words.
constructor.target_binding_limit: No target word, embryo, organ, or air-flow token is identified. This is an exploratory finite source mechanism only.
